beats.text: One major country breaks the pattern of its peers. It is not the one you'd guess.
China, India, or Nigeria. One of these giants has surprisingly low access.
It counts any home with a sink, bucket, or basin, as long as there is soap.
China has 95.3 percent. Almost every rural home there has soap and water ready.
India has 85.9 percent. That is 26 times the value Ethiopia has.
The outlier is Nigeria, at 22.9 percent. Far below its peers.
At the bottom: Ethiopia has 3.3 percent, and Liberia has just 1 percent.
Does your home have a dedicated spot for soap and water?
